method: Unique full Git commit identities reachable from the scanned application branch and worktree heads, including merge commits, bucketed by UTC committer date. No test, acceptance or merge-status filter.

scope.description: Locally available application integration and implementation branch heads, locally recorded remote-tracking branch heads and existing registered worktree heads in the legacy and current integration object stores.
scope.excluded: Website repository, uncommitted changes, reflogs, stash/tag/archive-only refs, backup-only refs and missing-worktree-only heads. No network refresh or unavailable external repositories. Work completed without a reachable commit is not counted.

qualification: Committed source activity, including untested and unmerged work, not feature completion, test passes or deployed releases. The final day is partial through the stated cutoff. Work without a reachable commit is excluded.
coverage: Lower bound for the explicitly scanned available refs. November 4–14 counts are not established; they are not displayed as zero. Other unavailable repositories or refs may contain additional commits.
